rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for doing or saying something again, and for something happening again.
Use this when explicitly repeating an action or restating someone's words, particularly in careful or formal speech.

example.english: Please repeat what you just said.
example.traditional: 請你重複一次頭先嗰句。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 cung4 fuk1 jat1 ci3 tau4 sin1 go2 geoi3

rows.note: Use this for an event recurring again, especially when the recurrence is unexpected or unwelcome rather than deliberately repeated.

example.english: It’s raining again; this may repeat tomorrow.

rows.note: Use this colloquial pattern when someone echoes or repeats what another person has said.

example.english: The kid will repeat whatever I say.
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 seng4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 ngo5 gong2
